Elk, Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre and Gunnison NF, USFS. Transfer of command from CIMT (RM Team 2) 
back to the local unit will occur today. CIMT is also managing the Gold Mountain incident. Seven miles 
northwest of Lake City, CO. Timber, brush and grass. Minimal fire behavior with creeping, single tree torching 
and smoldering. Structures threatened. Evacuations, area, road and trail closures in effect. 
 
Gold Mountain, Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre and Gunnison NF, USFS. Two miles north of Ouray, CO. Grass, 
brush and timber. Minimal fire behavior with creeping, single tree torching and smoldering. Energy 
infrastructure threatened. Area, road and trail closures in effect. 
 
Aspen Acres, Custer County. Twenty miles southwest of Pueblo, CO. Timber. Minimal fire behavior with 
creeping and smoldering. Communication infrastructure threatened. Area closures in effect. 
 
Willow, Pike and San Isabel NF, USFS. Six miles west of Leadville, CO. Brush, closed timber litter and timber. 
Minimal fire behavior. Communication infrastructure threatened. 
 
Rancher, Pine Ridge Agency, BIA. Two miles east of Evergreen, SD. Timber. Minimal fire behavior with 
smoldering. 
 
West Coal Creek, Campbell County. Forty-five miles north of Gillette, WY. Timber. Minimal fire behavior. Last 
report unless significant activity occurs.
